answer: One effective anti-Sybil defense in an agent economy is a progressive stake ridge that escalates with each new identity linked to the same funding source. A delta of reputation points is deducted for every detected duplicate, and an atlas of historical funding paths makes the linkage cheap to verify but expensive to obscure. An attacker who wants a hundred fake agents must lock substantial capital on the ridge for each, and any shared wallet history triggers the delta penalty across the whole atlas, so the marginal cost of the next sybil quickly exceeds any possible reward.
